lines.text: What time do you start work?
lines.speaker: Ivy

lines.text: I start at nine, but I leave home at eight.
lines.speaker: Noah

lines.text: Do you eat breakfast at home?
lines.speaker: Ivy

lines.text: No, I have breakfast at work.
lines.speaker: Noah

lines.text: What do you do after work?
lines.speaker: Ivy

lines.text: I usually take a walk by the river.
lines.speaker: Noah

lines.text: Only on weekdays. I stay home on Saturdays.
lines.speaker: Noah
